text:
idk why Occam's razor is the one that went platinum when there are other razors and blades, sharper and more versatile, in navigating daily life

these two swords cleave through knot after knot, leaving a trail of Gordian yarn in their wake

1. “Easy choices, hard life. Hard choices, easy life.”
2. “Right is right, wrong is wrong, and if you’re not sure if it’s right or wrong, it’s wrong.”

the second blade is deceptively simple, a moral guillotine which swiftly eliminates any chess-notation dubious move (??) and leaves no room for pushback. when you are right, and you've quadruple-checked your angles, and you know in God's eyes that you are right, you are right.

the combination yields bold, decisive action without fear of ambiguity. and so with respect to Occam, a thinker, we must also pay homage to the doers. 

in honor of a fallen philosopher-king, a brave warrior, and a man clearly from the lineage of Alexander, Caesar and Napoleon, I present to you...

⚔️ "The McAfee" ⚔️
